title: Release assertion
description: The provider's signed assertion of one module release (REQ-MDL-1, REQ-MDL-15): the capability declaration it releases and the portable binary of each of its two parts, by format and digest, in the provider-role statement envelope. Its maker is the provider, and it is signed under the provider-role signing rule (RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the whole envelope with only the top-level signature.value removed, Ed25519) with one of the keys the provider's advertisement publishes. That key is never the deployment's operator_key and never the declaration's statement_key, which the running outside part can resolve. Checking the key against the advertisement is done in Rust, not by this schema.

release.description: What the provider asserts it releases.

declaration.description: The release's capability declaration, whole (REQ-MDL-3). It names the module's provider and version.

parts.description: The portable binary of each part, both admitted, since the outside part holds real credentials (REQ-MDL-1, THR-82).

part.description: One part's portable binary: its format and the digest of its bytes.

format.description: The portable binary format, by name. The contract names no format: binding one, such as Wasm or PVM, is EXP-2's (DEC-4, REQ-MDL-15).
